description:
Step 2 of a bring-your-own-agent fact-check. Runs Storskarvia's own
        server-side retrieval (Wikipedia + searxng) for one claim and returns
        the sources -- no verdict, no judgment. Your agent should judge the
        claim ONLY against these returned sources, never outside knowledge.
        Requires a personal Storskarvia API key as a Bearer token (this is not an
        open retrieval API).
name: ground_claim
